title: Tierwise canonical vector
description: One canonical vector (spec section 12.4): one JCS encoding or one SHA-256 digest, checked against its expected bytes. A canonical vector has no bundle and no call. This schema checks structure only. The byte values, the code-point rules for strings and the surrogate rule of [VEC-79] are checked by the runner.

id.description: Vector identifier. It equals the file path relative to canonical/, without the .yaml extension ([VEC-11], [VEC-12]).

specVersion.description: Version of this specification that the vector targets. The value for this version is "0.1" ([VEC-14]).

clauses.description: Clause IDs that define the behaviour the vector checks ([VEC-16]).

description.description: One non-empty, single-line sentence that says what the vector checks ([VEC-17]).

primitive.description: The primitive under test: jcs for the JSON Canonicalization Scheme, or sha256 for the SHA-256 digest ([VEC-75]).

input.description: For a jcs vector, a value of the JSON data model written in YAML ([VEC-77]). For a sha256 vector, the bytes to hash, as a byte field ([VEC-81]). The shape is selected by primitive in the conditions of this schema.

expect.description: The expected result. For a jcs vector it is the expected bytes in output. For a sha256 vector it is the expected digest in digest ([VEC-77], [VEC-81]).

oneOf.description: A jcs vector: input is a JSON data value that [VEC-79] allows, and expect holds the expected bytes ([VEC-77], [VEC-78]).

primitive.description: Must be jcs in this branch.

input.description: A JSON data value, written in YAML ([VEC-79]).

oneOf.description: A sha256 vector: input is the bytes to hash, and expect holds the expected digest ([VEC-81], [VEC-82]).

primitive.description: Must be sha256 in this branch.

clauseId.description: A clause ID: an area prefix from spec.md, a hyphen and a number from 1 ([VEC-16]).

jcsValue.description: A value of the JSON data model that [VEC-79] allows as input to JCS: a string, a boolean, null, an array, an object, or an integer within plus or minus (2^53 - 1). A non-integer number is not allowed ([VEC-80]). Strings must not contain an unpaired surrogate, which this schema cannot check ([VEC-79]).

anyOf.description: A string, which may contain any code point except an unpaired surrogate ([VEC-79]).
An array of JSON data values, in order.
An object whose member names are strings, and whose member values are JSON data values.

An integer within plus or minus (2^53 - 1) ([VEC-79], [DET-4]). A JSON Schema check cannot tell the token 1.0 or 1e2 from 1 once the YAML is parsed, so it accepts an integral float. The runner rejects every float token, integral or not, as a runner failure ([VEC-35], [VEC-79]).

byteField.description: A byte sequence written with exactly one of two keys: utf8 for a string whose UTF-8 encoding is the bytes, or hex for lowercase hexadecimal of even length ([VEC-84]). A byte sequence that is not valid UTF-8 must use hex.

oneOf.description: The utf8 form. The string is encoded as UTF-8 exactly, with no added newline ([VEC-84]). A block scalar would add a trailing newline, so the value must be a quoted scalar or use |-.

utf8.description: The bytes as a string, encoded as UTF-8.

oneOf.description: The hex form. Lowercase hexadecimal digits in pairs, with the empty string for no bytes ([VEC-84]).

hex.description: The bytes as lowercase hexadecimal of even length. It must be a quoted string, so that YAML does not read it as a number.

jcsExpect.description: The expected result of a jcs vector: the expected JCS bytes ([VEC-77]).

output.description: The exact bytes of the JCS encoding of input ([VEC-78]).

sha256Expect.description: The expected result of a sha256 vector: the expected digest ([VEC-81], [VEC-82]).

digest.description: The expected SHA-256 digest, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters with no prefix, written as a quoted string ([VEC-83]).
